answer: Falcon-Sealed Work Receipts: each new agent identity must complete a paid task whose output is signed with a hardware enclave key tied to a unique silicon serial, and the enclave will forge only one seal per physical chip. A registry rejects any seal lacking an onyx-marked tamper certificate from the chip vendor, so cloning identities requires buying distinct certified hardware. Marginal clone cost becomes the chip plus certification, making each fake identity strictly negative-EV.
